title: A 2-Block Architecture for Real-Time EEG Gait Decoding: A Pilot Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.02083v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via Electroencephalography (EEG) remains limited by motion artifacts, low signal-to-noise ratio, and binary gait formulations that fail to capture full cortical gait complexity. We propose a 2-block Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) architecture: a trainable session-specific Feature Extraction Block with real-time artifact suppression and multi-domain feature extraction, coupled with a Decoder Block built on a novel Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM for four-state gait classification (Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate). translated_title: 一种用于实时EEG步态解码的2块架构：初步研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：通过脑电图（EEG）进行闭环下肢外骨骼控制仍受运动伪影、低信噪比以及无法捕捉完整皮层步态复杂性的二元步态表述限制。我们提出了一种2块脑机接口（BCI）架构：一个可训练的会话特定特征提取块，具有实时伪影抑制和多域特征提取，结合基于新型多项式时变层（PolyTVL）+LSTM的解码块，用于四状态步态分类（站立、启动、执行、终止）。消融实验确认v01（PolyTVL+LSTM）优于所有变体（验证MCC：0.435，差距：0.187），并且在ROI和子带间EEG特征可区分性一致（p<0.05）。使用v01的闭环部署实现了55.3%（Rex辅助）和52.7%（自主）的步态启动成功率，平均端到端处理时间为70.5毫秒（±41.5），验证了实时性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种包含特征提取块和PolyTVL+LSTM解码块的2块BCI架构，用于四状态实时步态解码，并通过闭环实验验证了其有效性和实时性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a 2-block BCI architecture with a feature extraction block and a PolyTVL+LSTM decoder for four-state real-time gait decoding, validated by closed-loop experiments for effectiveness and real-time performance.
